highlights.title: Built for two markets
highlights.text: UK and US plumbing work differently: Gas Safe and WaterSafe in the UK, state and local licensing in the USA. We keep them separate.

highlights.title: Compare, don't guess
highlights.text: Quote marketplaces, review directories and local firms each have pros and cons. We lay them out side by side.

highlights.title: Honest introductions
highlights.text: We're an introduction service, not a plumbing firm. We say when a link is a partner link, and never make up reviews or prices.

sections.h2: Ways to find a local plumber, compared
sections.html:
There's no single best route. It depends on how urgent the job is and how many quotes you want.

RouteHow it worksGood forWatch out for
Quote marketplacePost one request; several local plumbers contact you or send quotes.Getting several quotes quickly for planned jobs.Check each plumber yourself: being listed isn't the same as being qualified.
Review directoryBrowse plumbers with profiles and customer reviews, then contact the ones you like.Comparing track records in your area.Read recent reviews and check how the site verifies them.
Official registerSearch a register such as Gas Safe or WaterSafe (UK) or your state licence lookup (USA).Confirming someone is qualified for the work.Registers confirm qualifications, not price or availability.
Local firm directCall a plumber you've used before or one recommended by neighbours.Emergencies and repeat work.Still ask for a written quote and check registration or licence.

In the UK, anyone working on gas appliances such as boilers must be on the Gas Safe Register. WaterSafe lists plumbers approved to work on water fittings. See plumbers in the UK.

In the USA, plumbers are usually licensed, mostly by the state and in some places by the city or county. Bigger jobs often need a permit and inspection. See plumbers in the USA.

faqs.a: Yes. The finder and guides are free and you don't need an account. If you use a partner link we may earn a referral fee from that partner, at no extra cost to you.
No. LocalPlumbers is a comparison and introduction service. We don't employ, train or vet plumbers, so always check registrations, licences and insurance before work starts.

faqs.q: Why do I have to choose a country and region first?
faqs.a: The rules, registers and quote services are different in the UK and the USA, and they vary by nation and state. Choosing your area first means the advice and introductions you see apply where you live.

faqs.q: Do you store my postcode or ZIP code?
faqs.a: No. The optional town or postcode field stays in your browser for this visit only and isn't sent to us.

faqs.q: What should I do in a plumbing emergency?
faqs.a: Turn off your water at the stopcock (UK) or main shutoff valve (USA). If you smell gas, leave and call the gas emergency number: 0800 111 999 in Great Britain, 0800 002 001 in Northern Ireland, or 911 or your gas utility in the USA. Then see our emergency plumber guide.
